about: Rule cards of t3: each card switches one rule off in a scratch copy of the submission (lab ablate).

cards.rule: Before the system change of 2007-08-11 COBOL cut units and cents off and charged management fees by days / 360
cards.off: every booking computed like Neuron NG

cards.rule: On the same day the monthly charge run is booked before the premiums and the customer orders
cards.off: every booking of a day in the order of its event number

cards.rule: A premium buys units on the first price date of the fund after the money date
cards.off: on the last price date on or before the money date

cards.rule: A restated unit price replaces the earlier publication (latest FP_CHGTS)
cards.off: the first publication of the price

cards.rule: A premium is converted with the exchange rate of the day before the trade date
cards.off: the exchange rate of the trade date

cards.rule: No surrender penalty in a waiver period of NRWAIV
cards.off: the penalty of the scale on every day

edits.old: if any(waiver["WV_VLDFR"] <= day_ <= waiver["WV_VLDTO"] for waiver in self.waivers):

cards.rule: An individual agreement (NRAGRE) replaces the management charge rate of the tariff
cards.off: the rate of the tariff for every policy
